records.name: Auspician
gaps: Faiths & Pantheons Auspician needs chaotic alignment, Dodge/Great Fortitude/Iron Will/Lightning Reflexes, Fort +5/Ref +2, Luck domain and Tyche's-blood initiation enforced, plus full casting advancement and its Fate/Luck-domain, Lucky Blow, Tyche's Curse, infusion and daily luck resources.
records.nextAction: Implement exact entry gates, selectable existing-caster advancement, Fate/Luck domain state, daily Luck Infusion/Mark choices, Tyche's Curse uses, Lucky Blow scaling and Luck of the Gods.

records.name: Avenging Executioner
gaps: Avenging Executioner needs nongood alignment, BAB +5, Hide 4/Intimidate 6/Move Silently 4 and tragic-wrong prerequisites, plus sudden-strike scaling and fear/intimidation state.
records.nextAction: Enforce exact entry requirements; add sudden-strike progression, Bloody Blade/Bloody Murder fear saves, Rapid Intimidation and Dread Blade reminders/state, then level regressions.

records.name: Ballisteer
gaps: The Mind's Eye 3.0 Ballisteer needs BAB +3, Tumble 6, Dodge/Mobility/Point Blank Shot/Psionic Shot and 2nd-level manifesting, plus its legacy psychic-warrior power-point/power-discovery schedule and point-spending shot abilities.
records.nextAction: Keep this 3.0 record source-specific; implement exact entry gates, legacy manifesting progression and power-point shot resources without inheriting later 3.5 conversions.

records.name: Bane of Infidels
records.sourceBook: Prestige Class Masters of the Wild: A Guidebook to Barbarians, Druids, and Rangers
gaps: Bane of Infidels needs nongood alignment, Intimidate 4, Knowledge (religion) 6, Knowledge (nature) 6, Iron Will, Leadership and 3rd-level divine casting, then full selected-class casting plus sacrifice/pyre/loyalty field mechanics.
records.nextAction: Enforce exact prerequisites, selectable divine casting target and level-by-level supernatural/spell-like resources for energumen, pyre, sacrifices, wicker man, bonfire and antipathy.

records.name: Battle Maiden
gaps: Oriental Adventures Battle Maiden needs female, lawful, BAB +7, Handle Animal 10, Ride 10, Mounted Combat, Ride-By Attack and Spirited Charge, plus a source-specific special mount and mounted defensive/resource progression.
records.nextAction: Implement exact entry gates, OA training, special-mount state/progression, Ride bonus milestones, Burst of Speed, Defensive Riding and Heal Mount uses.

records.name: Battle Scion
gaps: Battle Scion has weapon-defined entry requirements rather than one fixed prerequisite set; its legendary weapon owns additional level abilities while the class independently grants fighter bonus feats at 1/4/7/10.
records.nextAction: Model legendary-weapon selection as required source state, validate that weapon's own entry criteria, separate weapon-owned abilities from class-owned bonus feats, and regression-test loss/recovery of the weapon.

records.name: Battle Trickster
gaps: Battle Trickster needs BAB +5, any three skills at 6 ranks and any two skill tricks, then grants bonus skill tricks, a fighter bonus feat and Tricky Fighting.
records.nextAction: Add structured skill-trick prerequisites/ownership, guided bonus-trick choices, fighter-bonus-feat choice and Tricky Fighting reminder/state across all three levels.

records.name: Battlerager
gaps: Races of Faerûn Battlerager needs dwarf, nonlawful alignment, BAB +5, Intimidate 8, Knowledge (religion) 2, Perform 2, Cleave, Endurance, Power Attack and rage, plus extra-rage, fixed feats and natural-armor/fear-resistance features.
records.nextAction: Enforce the complete source entry gate; stack rage uses safely, grant source feats at the proper levels, and model Gruff/Rock Gut/Fearless/Natural Armor without conflating other battleragers.

records.name: Battlesmith
gaps: Battlesmith needs dwarf, BAB +5, Craft (armorsmithing or weaponsmithing) 10, heavy-armor proficiency, Endurance, Weapon Focus (warhammer), and creation/use of a dwarvencraft weapon, plus crafted-warhammer and forge abilities.
records.nextAction: Implement exact entry prerequisites including the crafted-weapon event, then source-owned warhammer Wisdom damage, forge crafting benefits, Flesh of My Flesh scaling and fire/blood defenses.

records.name: Bayushi Deceiver
gaps: Oriental Adventures Bayushi Deceiver needs human (Scorpion), nonlawful alignment, BAB +3, Bluff 8, Diplomacy 8, Improved Initiative and sneak attack +2d6, plus source-specific poison, feint and sneak-attack progression.
records.nextAction: Implement exact clan/race/alignment/skill/feat/sneak-attack gates; add sneak-attack scaling, Poison Use, Strike First/Last, Scorpion Feint and fixed Improved Disarm/Improved Critical grants.

records.name: Bear Warrior
gaps: Complete Warrior Bear Warrior needs BAB +7, Power Attack and rage/frenzy; its bear form is tied to rage, progresses black→brown→dire at 1/5/10, gains Scent at 3 and +1 rage/day at 7.
records.nextAction: Implement CW-specific entry gates and rage-linked form state/stat changes, Scent and extra-rage resource; do not inherit Oriental Adventures timing or proficiencies.

records.name: Bear Warrior
gaps: Oriental Adventures Bear Warrior needs BAB +7, Power Attack and rage/fury/ki frenzy; unlike Complete Warrior it grants martial/simple proficiency, separate bear-form uses/timing (1/4/8) and extra raging at 5/10.
records.nextAction: Implement the OA record independently with its own proficiencies, black/brown/dire use progression, Scent and extra-rage milestones; regression-lock same-name source isolation.

records.name: Beast Heart Adept
gaps: Beast Heart Adept needs Handle Animal 8, Knowledge (arcana) 4, Knowledge (dungeoneering) 4, Animal Affinity and a week alone in a dungeon, plus a selectable monstrous companion and companion/monster-lore progression.
records.nextAction: Implement exact entry requirements, reusable monstrous-companion state/advancement and Monster Lore plus later companion/tactical features, then persistence/removal regressions.

records.name: Beastmaster
gaps: Complete Adventurer Beastmaster needs Handle Animal 8, Survival 4 and Skill Focus (Handle Animal), then an animal companion at effective druid level class+3, stacking wild empathy, extra companions and daily Speak with Animals.
records.nextAction: Implement exact entry gate and reusable multi-companion state, effective companion levels/penalties, wild-empathy stacking, Alertness, low-light/scent and Speak with Animals counters.

records.name: Beholder Mage
gaps: Lords of Madness Beholder Mage needs a true beholder that destroys its central antimagic eye; it has a unique Intelligence spontaneous arcane progression, caster level twice class level, spell-stalk eye-ray sacrifice, Arcane Hands and Ocular Transformation.
records.nextAction: Implement LoM-specific race/special prerequisite and independent spell-learning/slot/caster-level model, spell-stalk ownership plus Arcane Hands/Ocular Transformation state; never inherit the older Monsters of Faerûn class.

records.name: Beholder Mage
records.sourceBook: Prestige Class Monster Compendium: Monsters of Faerûn
gaps: Monsters of Faerûn Beholder Mage is a distinct 3.0 record: beholder race plus destroyed central eye, wizard-style spell preparation, a different save/special table including Summon Familiar, and source-specific casting progression.
records.nextAction: Keep the 3.0 record independent; implement its exact race/special gate, prepared-casting table, familiar grant and source progression without borrowing Lords of Madness spontaneous/stalk mechanics.

records.name: Beloved of Valarian
records.sourceBook: Prestige Class Book of Exalted Deeds
gaps: Beloved of Valarian needs female, good alignment, BAB +7, Knowledge (nature) 5, Ride 10, Mounted Combat, Sacred Vow, Vow of Chastity and the druid-grove animal-rescue initiation, plus its own spell table and unicorn/celestial-charger progression.
records.nextAction: Implement exact exalted entry gate, class spell list/slots, unicorn→celestial charger companion state, telepathic/timeless/ethereal features and daily Holy Smite/Mass Baleful Polymorph resources.

records.name: Bereft
gaps: Tome of Magic Bereft needs neutral alignment, Truespeak 13, at least three languages and the 3,700 gp ritual of renaming, then Obscure Personal Truename and syllable/Word of Unmaking Truespeech mechanics.
records.nextAction: Add exact alignment/skill/language/ritual gate, source feat grant and a reusable Truespeech/Truespeak action model for the syllables and Word of Unmaking, with explicit XP/cost reminders.

records.name: Berserk
gaps: Deities and Demigods Berserk needs nonlawful alignment, BAB +5, medium armor proficiency, Shield Proficiency, Martial Weapon Proficiency in battleaxe/longsword/warhammer and Asgardian patronage, plus battle-fury, DR, speed and totem beast-shape resources.
records.nextAction: Implement exact entry gate including pantheon and weapon-choice requirement; add Battle Fury uses, movement/DR progression and chosen beast-shape uses/state across ten levels.

records.name: Black Blood Cultist
gaps: Black Blood Cultist needs CE/CN/NE alignment, Knowledge (nature) 2, Survival 8, Improved Unarmed Strike, Track and rage; its class stacks rage and adds claws, bite, rend, grapple, DR/silver, scent and feral-form state.
records.nextAction: Enforce exact entry gates; stack rage progression safely and model natural attacks, Improved Grapple, DR/silver, Scent, Stranglehold, Savage Grapple and Feral Form with level regressions.
